tasks.completion_summary: Extracted ScriptRegistry into go-cli-server/script package with Registry, Entry, State, Config types and MakeProcessID helper. All 27 tests pass with race detector.

Wired ScriptRegistry into ProcessManager with automatic lifecycle updates (start/stop/fail/restart) and opt-in output streaming via OutputCallback and lineWriter. All 56 process tests and 27 script tests pass with race detector.

Added SCRIPT verb handlers (LIST/GET/OUTPUT/RESTART/STOP) to go-cli-server Hub with directory filtering, session fallback, and 18 integration tests. Protocol constants VerbScript and SubVerbRestart added.

Replaced agnt internal ScriptRegistry with go-cli-server script.Registry; removed script_registry.go and _test.go; updated daemon.go, hub_handlers.go, process_autorestart.go, daemon_test.go to use script.Entry/State types; wired ProcessManager.SetScriptRegistry for automatic lifecycle updates; kept SCRIPT handlers in agnt for auto-restart management.
